description.value: REVS Burnaby bills itself as Western Canada's largest 10-pin bowling centre, with 48 lanes accommodating up to 300 people and a full-service entertainment complex under one roof. Beyond bowling, the facility includes a fitness centre with five racquetball courts, a cardio room, strength training area, and a boxing club operated by the North Burnaby Boxing Club. Striker's Bar & Restaurant serves meals and handcrafted pizzas on site, and the venue is located directly beside the Holdom SkyTrain station.
